scope: Whole 40-record batch judged once against the fixed module and pool; shared guesses and graph bridges only, with no curated target or round approval.
method: Independent live checks of the second Romanian websites and named maker/domain evidence; no dexonline requests, reserved for the factual reviewer to preserve global spacing. Compared all destination senses with the live bundle, checked four distinct targets, existing/batch and category counts, and independently confirmed no live normalized owner collision in 133 submitted new surfaces. Wiktionary may derive lexical material from DEX; independent lexical provenance is not claimed.

items.rationale: Keep held. The familiar clothing sense and hand/winter links are useful, but the fourth cap association remains a winter-kit co-listing rather than an independently meaningful fourth link; recognition cannot fill the missing same-category association.

Recognizable clothing part with four concrete fastener associations to existing owners. Shirt, jacket and trouser maker descriptions support the qualified captions; these are actual part/use relations, not equipment co-listing. The proposed masculine inputs stay within the submitted sense.

A familiar sewn clothing compartment with four honest existing garment destinations and legible part_of captions. Maker pages independently corroborate shirt, jacket and trouser pockets; the unchanged parent clothing sense is respected.

Useful household vocabulary whose yard, garden, wood and house-land associations read naturally. The revised garden destination has the correct ordinary scope, resolving the prior monumental-gate mismatch; all four links reach existing owners.

A familiar preserving vessel grounded in Romanian home cooking. Jam, pickles, winter preserves and the closing lid are direct functional associations, including three existing gastronomic owners and one accepted batch dependency.

A common kitchen cover with honest part_of associations to pot, saucepan, frying pan and jar. Manufacturer and preserving instructions support the qualified uses; three targets already exist and the jar dependency is explicit.

A recognizable home-coffee vessel with meaningful beverage, named preparation, water and stove associations. The coffee-maker instructions directly support the submitted functions; the ordinary coffee parent and the specific preparation are correctly distinguished.

Recognizable kitchen vocabulary with four practical separation/draining links. The submitted perforated and cloth variants retain one utensil sense; the pot-mounted product independently corroborates draining pasta/vegetables, while the lexical evidence supplies cloth whey separation.

Keep held. The exact house-sparrow identity is familiar and SOR supports insect food and Romanian presence, but generic seeds do not establish the specifically planned wheat link. The proposal still lacks complete evidence for its four-target plan.

School-level bird vocabulary with a readable bird parent, tree-foraging habitat, insect food and strong-beak relation. Three targets already exist; the single beak dependency is explicit and the description avoids an unsupported universal diet.

Familiar bird anatomy gives a legible part_of bridge to bird and woodpecker, plus mouth and bony-support associations. The destinations retain anatomical meanings and the source supports the horny jaws with bone support; the human figurative sense is excluded.

Common Romanian fauna with four readable insect, blood, aquatic-larva and frog-prey associations. Female feeding is explicitly qualified to many species and frog predation is possible rather than universal, preserving the actual scope of the evidence.

Recognizable garden animal with meaningful animal-parent, soil, hedgehog-food and fishing-bait links. The Romanian conservation teaching guide directly supports the local hedgehog association and the angler describes actual bait use; no plant or generic-prey inference is needed.

Keep held. The social insect is recognizable, but neither generic seed feeding nor generic insect predation establishes the predeclared wheat and hedgehog claims. Familiarity does not replace four truthful scoped links.

Familiar school and garden insect; the description restricts the seven-spotted species instead of assigning its appearance to every ladybird. Insect identity, plant protection, leaf foraging and aphid prey provide four intelligible associations, with only one batch dependency.

A concrete garden pest and nature-study term, with an accessible plant-louse description. Romanian educational ecology and growers corroborate relevance; insect identity, sap feeding, leaf habitat and ladybird predation are meaningful links. The exact submitted lemma Afid keeps the normative input scope; no owner is renamed.

Keep held. The arachnid identity and general insect diet are clear, and the reviewed Wikipedia page even supports butterfly prey for particular crab spiders. It does not settle the full specifically planned mosquito/butterfly pair of claims, so the four-target evidence remains incomplete; never classify the spider as an insect.

Keep held. The common sound-producing insect passes recognition, but the planned grass/leaf diet and hedgehog-prey associations are not all source-qualified. A habitat statement or generic omnivory cannot stand in for those precise food links.

Citation-only correction; the submitted concept and four driving/part links pass quality. The live Wiktionary entry defines decorative fabric, so its vehicle-sense paraphrase must be removed or corrected. The independently checked Renault guide supports the steering/driving sense and provides the second Romanian website; no new or changed edge claim is requested.

Everyday vehicle glass with direct car/bus part relations, a qualified driver-protection function and the specifically Romanian parking-note association. The latter matches the existing note owner exactly and is documented by a concrete report; these are four meaningful existing destinations.

A familiar vehicle component whose four part_of links read naturally for car, bicycle, motorcycle and train. The explicit vehicle scope excludes unrelated circular-object senses and supplies useful shared-graph bridges to four existing transport owners.

Citation-only correction; the tyre concept and four submitted associations pass quality. The existing Michelin partner URL supports cars/motorcycles but does not mention bicycles. Use the independently checked Romanian manufacturer bicycle-tyre page for that already submitted claim and correct the overbroad original paraphrase; no content or edge change is requested.

Universally recognizable school road-education vocabulary. Car circulation, driver instructions, the red stop indication and light signalling are defining functions with exact scoped captions; two same-category existing destinations and four existing targets satisfy the connectivity requirement.

Familiar Romanian urban transport with readable bus similarity, driver, electric traction and street associations. The submitted definition distinguishes the electric contact-wire vehicle from a bus and the links express its actual operation rather than a generic occupation frame.

Recognizable railway vocabulary with meaningful train, station water replenishment, electric traction and wheel associations. Steam/electric variants are explicitly qualified and the ordinary-wheel caption avoids a universal Maglev assertion; three targets already exist.
